title: A new number that looks like a part at another location is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, so a rename reaches location B too.
  • Create a part, part B, for this test at location B only, so location B stocks a part the new number will look like.
  • Use a new number for part A that differs from part B's number only by a hyphen or a period, so the two numbers match once punctuation is ignored, but no entry has it exactly.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with the look-alike number.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Wait 5 seconds.
  6. Click Cancel.
  7. Pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  8. Click Parts in the top bar.
  9. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  10. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the look-alike number.

Step 4:

  • The save is refused and the window stays open.
  • A red message reads part B's number followed by "already exists at" and location B's name, then a full stop, with a smaller second line "Please try to resolve this."
  • The message is not "already belongs to another part in the Part Library.": no entry has exactly the typed number.

Step 5:

  • The red message has gone on its own after about 3 seconds, and the window is still open.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and part A is still listed under its old number.

Step 7:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 8:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 9:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 10:

  • Part B is listed at location B with its own number, unchanged.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • User Feedback Summary: “Renamed number matches a part at another location that stocks it | "{existing part number} already exists at {location}." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds; the dialog stays open”
